mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS fill_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN side='BUY' THEN allocated_qty ELSE 0 END),0) AS bought_qty, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN side='SELL' THEN allocated_qty ELSE 0 END),0) AS sold_qty, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN side='BUY' THEN allocated_qty*allocated_price ELSE 0 END),0) AS bought_notional, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN side='SELL' THEN allocated_qty*allocated_price ELSE 0 END),0) AS sold_notional, COALESCE(SUM(allocated_fee),0) AS total_fees, COUNT(DISTINCT allocated_fee_asset) AS fee_asset_count, MIN(allocated_fee_asset) AS fee_asset, COALESCE(SUM(realized_pnl),0) AS realized_pnl FROM quant_strategy_fill_allocation WHERE credential_id=#{credentialId} AND strategy_id=#{strategyId} AND strategy_instance_id=#{instanceId} AND symbol=#{symbol}

SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(UPPER(TRIM(allocated_fee_asset)),''),'UNKNOWN') AS fee_asset, COALESCE(SUM(allocated_fee),0) AS total_fees FROM quant_strategy_fill_allocation WHERE credential_id=#{credentialId} AND strategy_id=#{strategyId} AND strategy_instance_id=#{instanceId} AND symbol=#{symbol} GROUP BY COALESCE(NULLIF(UPPER(TRIM(allocated_fee_asset)),''),'UNKNOWN') ORDER BY fee_asset
